cases.name: Maria Larin
cases.about: Native of El Salvador and worked as a hotwalker, walking horses to help them cool down after racing, at the Belmont Racetrack. Described by those who knew her as a very pleasant woman who had a good heart and was always trying to send money back to her kid in El Salvador.
cases.narrative: As she worked, he approached and brutally stabbed and slashed her more than 20 times multiple times all over her body with a silver kitchen knife before he was restrained by staff at the racetrack.
